name: Sosei
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 21); Porter’s note gives the dates as: b. c. 850.

poems.title: The moon that shone the whole night through
poems.author: Sosei
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 21
poems.text:
The moon that shone the whole night through
This autumn morn I see,
As here I wait thy well-known step,
For thou didst promise me—
‘I’ll surely come to thee.’

poems.title: 21. 今来むと いひしばかりに 長月の (Ima komu to iishi bakari ni nagatsuki no)
poems.author: Sosei
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 古今集
poems.text:
今来むと いひしばかりに 長月の
有明の月を 待ち出でつるかな
